name: Intsig Information Co., Ltd.
summary: Intsig Information Co., Ltd. research and develops text recognition and commercial big data core technologies in China. The company offers CamCard, a business card and contact management app; CamScanner, a scanning and text recognition app; Qixinbao, an enterprise information query app; Qixin Insight SaaS Platform; and TextIn product.
